instruction: A faceted hot air balloon assembled from flat cardstock panels, its teardrop envelope built from alternating cream, coral, and teal gores with visible glue tabs and crease seams. Four paper cords descend to a woven-look kraft basket folded from corrugated stock with a scalloped rim. The panel edges are slightly raised and the matte paper shows a subtle fiber grain.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Papercraft Hot Air Balloon in a papercraft style. A faceted hot air balloon assembled from flat cardstock panels, its teardrop envelope built from alternating cream, coral, and teal gores with visible glue tabs and crease seams. Four paper cords descend to a woven-look kraft basket folded from corrugated stock with a scalloped rim. The panel edges are slightly raised and the matte paper shows a subtle fiber grain. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
